final: WITH site_avgs AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS status_avg_faces FROM site_avgs WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg_faces FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), qualifying AS (SELECT sa.avg_faces, sa.avg_faces - oa.overall_avg_faces AS above_overall, sa.avg_faces - sta.status_avg_faces AS above_status FROM site_avgs AS sa JOIN status_avgs AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa WHERE sa.avg_faces > sta.status_avg_faces AND oa.overall_avg_faces IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS average_face_count, AVG(above_overall) AS average_above_overall, AVG(above_status) AS average_above_status FROM qualifying
